core_obligations: Record the flat base change isomorphism H^i(P^n_{k'}, F') = H^i(P^n_k, F)  tensor _k k' for all i (coherent-lemma-flat-base-change-cohomology) (proof lines 6627-6635).

Read off both directions: the vanishing defining m-regularity is preserved since tensoring with k' preserves zero, and conversely a k'-vector space that vanishes after tensoring with k' is zero; the multiplication maps are obtained by tensoring, and surjectivity is preserved by right exactness of  tensor  (proof lines 6627-6635).
proof_roadmap: Base-change the cohomology groups; vanishing and surjectivity tests transfer through the field extension.
